regra: Nenhum slide inventa conteúdo. Cada linha vem do texto do post correspondente em posts.json, encurtada para caber — nunca acrescentada. Se um fato não está no post, não entra no carrossel.

carrosseis.capa: Five levels. One question: can a buyer act on your file without calling you?

slides.linha: No file exists.
Every request becomes a project.
Records exist, gaps unknown.
A buyer can act on the file.
The next request is an export, not an emergency.

carrosseis.fecho: Most Brazilian exporters sit at 1 or 2. The jump that puts revenue on the table is 2 → 3.
carrosseis.fecho_linha: The model is public and citable.

carrosseis.titulo_documento: What a CBAM data request actually asks for
carrosseis.capa: What a CBAM data request actually asks a Brazilian producer for. Not the regulation — the e-mail.

slides.linha: Which plant produced the goods.
Blast furnace vs. electric arc; primary vs. secondary aluminium.
Fuels and process emissions attributable to the goods.
Electricity consumed, with the emission factor used.
Embedded emissions of inputs already covered.
How the figures were obtained, by whom, for which period.
Whether any third party has reviewed the data.

carrosseis.fecho: Most Brazilian files answer 1 and 2 immediately, 3 and 4 after internal negotiation, and 5–7 not at all.
carrosseis.fecho_linha: Items 5–7 are where the importer decides whether your number is usable.

carrosseis.titulo_documento: An EUDR supplier file a buyer can use — six folders
carrosseis.capa: The structure of an EUDR supplier file that a buyer can use. Six folders. No software required.

slides.linha: Every farm, cooperative or intermediary, with role and tier.
One entry per plot, point or polygon, source and date of the coordinate.
Harvest / slaughter / felling dates per plot, tied to the cut-off date.
Plot → intermediary → processing → export lot, with documents at each hand-over.
Per obligation category: which document, which issuer, which validity.
What is missing, who owns it, by when. Labelled fact / interpretation / hypothesis.

carrosseis.fecho: A buyer who receives these six folders can run its own risk assessment in days instead of weeks.

carrosseis.capa: The one-page supplier evidence index. If you build only one document this quarter, build this.

slides.linha: The request or clause. "CBAM embedded emissions, plant X."
Which regulation or contract it comes from.
Who asked, or who can ask.
The record that satisfies it: name, date, issuer.
Fact / interpretation / hypothesis / absent.
One name.
Expiry, renewal, next request.

carrosseis.fecho: A file that answers the next questionnaire in hours. A gap list the board can fund. A SEMM level you can defend.
carrosseis.fecho_linha: It is a spreadsheet. The discipline is what makes it evidence.

carrosseis.titulo_documento: Thirty notes on EU–Brazil supplier evidence
carrosseis.capa: European buyers decide on evidence. Most Brazilian evidence is not yet usable by anyone outside the company that holds it.

slides.linha: SEMM levels, questionnaires, fact / interpretation / hypothesis.
Definitive period, default values as a price problem, who owns the number.
30 December 2026, geolocation, legality, the file behind the DDS.
The CSRD value-chain cap, contract clauses, the board file.
Your emissions at the Brazilian end of your buyer's chain.

carrosseis.fecho: The common failure is not the operation. It is a file that depends on one person remembering where things are.
carrosseis.fecho_linha: One owner, one index, one review cadence.
